_readme: Lunar target profile per base type, in the SAME terms as the Earth pipeline (src/pipeline/polar.py):
same criterion ids, units and definitions, computed on the same 60 m grid with the same windows.
The pipeline only uses a value when verified = true (set by whoever computed it from the named source).
No 0-1 scores here: the lunar site is the reference that Earth cells are scored against.
Draft numbers that do not match a pipeline definition are kept under draft_reference, unused.

polar.label: Shackleton rim + floor (lunar south pole)
polar.status: computed 2026-11-14 by src/compute_lunar_target.py with the Earth pipeline code (pipeline.polar._Cell.place) on the 60 m grid

grid.crs: lunar south polar stereographic (sphere R = 1737.4 km)

polar.window: 15 km square centred on the crater low point, found from the data (largest depth x width depression within 15 km of the pole)

c7_bowl.label: 7 Bowl shape
c7_bowl.definition: candidate places = closed depressions >= 50 m deep and >= 1000 m wide whose low point is in the window (searched with a 5 km margin); value = spill depth / equivalent diameter of the chosen place
c7_bowl.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF (Barker et al. 2023, PGDA product 90), +-25 km window around the pole read via /vsicurl/
c7_bowl.zone: whole crater = filled closed depression (cyan outline)

c9_relief.label: 9 Rim-to-floor depth
c9_relief.definition: median over 1-deg azimuth sectors of the highest elevation within rim_search_rel x bowl radius of the low point, minus the low point; no bowl -> 0
c9_relief.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF (Barker et al. 2023, PGDA product 90), +-25 km window around the pole read via /vsicurl/
c9_relief.zone: whole bowl: rim crest within 1.3 x bowl radius of the floor low point
c9_relief.stat: median over 1-deg azimuth sectors of the highest elevation, minus the low point (size-dependent: large tolerance)

c10_flat_base.label: 10 Flat base spot
c10_flat_base.definition: mean slope of the flattest ~200 m pad (3x3 px at 60 m) outside the bowl whose centre is at most max_base_to_bowl_km outside the bowl edge
c10_flat_base.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF (Barker et al. 2023, PGDA product 90), +-25 km window around the pole read via /vsicurl/
c10_flat_base.zone: rim: outside the bowl, pad centre at most 1 km outside the bowl edge
c10_flat_base.stat: minimum over 3x3 px (180 m) pads of the mean slope

c11_walls.label: 11 Steep walls
c11_walls.definition: mean slope in a ring of wall_ring_rel x r around the low point, r = equivalent radius of the filled depression (inner walls only)
c11_walls.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF (Barker et al. 2023, PGDA product 90), +-25 km window around the pole read via /vsicurl/
c11_walls.zone: inner wall: ring 4.76-9.51 km around the low point (= 0.5-1.0 x bowl radius, r = equivalent radius of the filled depression)

c13_roughness.label: 13 Roughness
c13_roughness.definition: median std of elevation in 3x3 px windows over the bowl + rim ring (bowl plus everything within rim_search_rel x r of the low point)
c13_roughness.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF (Barker et al. 2023, PGDA product 90), +-25 km window around the pole read via /vsicurl/
c13_roughness.zone: bowl + rim ring: the bowl plus everything within 1.3 x bowl radius of the low point (same zone as on Earth)
c13_roughness.stat: median of the 3x3 px elevation std

c14_aspect.label: 14 Pole-facing slopes
c14_aspect.definition: share of steep pixels (> 20 deg) within the wall ring's outer radius facing the nearer pole (+-45 deg)
c14_aspect.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF (Barker et al. 2023, PGDA product 90), +-25 km window around the pole read via /vsicurl/
c14_aspect.zone: within 9.51 km (ring outer radius) of the low point
c14_aspect.stat: share of pixels steeper than 20 deg whose downslope direction is within +-45 deg of the pole direction. DISPLAY ONLY (weight 0, 14 Nov): Shackleton sits practically on the pole, so 'toward the pole' is a different direction for each part of the wall; not comparable with Earth

sunny_ridge.pipeline: light criteria 1-5 via src/shadowsim, not wired into run_pipeline yet
sunny_ridge.note: 0.85 was an illustrative placeholder from a chat format example, not a measurement (removed 14 Nov 2026 after Mateo's review). Rim lit fraction will come from a lunar illumination map (light criteria, Mateo).

dark_floor.pipeline: light criteria 1-5 via src/shadowsim, not wired in yet

relief_rim_floor.zone: rim crest per 1-deg azimuth to the lowest floor point
relief_rim_floor.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF via src/compute_lunar_target.py (20 m -> 60 m): median over 1-deg azimuth sectors of the highest elevation within 1.3 x bowl radius (rim crest, median 1205 m), minus the floor low point (-2869 m)
relief_rim_floor.note: Same quantity as criterion c9 since 14 Nov (display only, weight 0). Replaces a 4100 m placeholder from a chat example. Mateo's src/moon_dem.py gives 3987 m from the same file: rim median 1115 m on a ring around a crater centre fitted to the rim crest, 30 m grid, minus floor min -2872 m. The ~86 m difference comes from the rim definition (per-azimuth highest point vs median on a fixed ring, which also samples lower parts of the rim) and the grid (60 vs 30 m). Spill depth (lowest rim saddle to floor) is 3753 m.

bare_ground.why_unused: land cover is a hard filter in the Earth pipeline (config filter), not a scored criterion

draft_scores.why_unused: 0-1 scores for the target itself from a chat example, no source; set to null 14 Nov 2026. Earth cells are scored against the lunar raw values, not against target scores.

place._note: display values, not scored (scale decision 14 Nov: size-dependent)
place.zones_how: floor = bowl pixels < 10 deg connected to the low point; inner wall = bowl pixels between floor and rim crest; rim crest = highest point within 1.3 x bowl radius per 1 deg azimuth

cross_check._note: Independent computation by Mateo on branch moon-targets (src/moon_targets.py, src/moon_dem.py), merged 14 Nov 2026. Same source file (LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF) but the OLD pipeline definitions (c9 5 km window, c11 fixed 0.5-3 km ring, c10 within 5 km of the low point), cell centred on IAU coordinates of Shackleton. Not used for scoring; kept to compare.

c7_bowl.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF via src/moon_targets.py (Mateo, old definitions, 14 Nov 2026)

c9_relief.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF via src/moon_targets.py (Mateo, old definitions, 14 Nov 2026)

c10_flat_base.note: TODO: with max_base_to_low_km = 5 the pad is searched within 5 km of the low point, i.e. on Shackleton's floor/lower wall (permanently dark), not on the rim where NASA's base sites are (~10 km out). Kept as is for v1; revisit the search radius.
c10_flat_base.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF via src/moon_targets.py (Mateo, old definitions, 14 Nov 2026)

c11_walls.note: TODO: the wall ring (polar.wall_ring_m = 500-3000 m from the low point) covers Shackleton's floor and the foot of its walls; the steep inner walls run ~3-10 km out, so this value understates them. Kept as is for v1; revisit a ring scaled to the depression size.
c11_walls.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF via src/moon_targets.py (Mateo, old definitions, 14 Nov 2026)

c13_roughness.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF via src/moon_targets.py (Mateo, old definitions, 14 Nov 2026)

c14_aspect.note: Shackleton's rim touches the lunar south pole and the Sun circles the whole horizon there, so 'facing the pole' does not mean 'less sun' as it does on Earth. Computed value kept in the note for reference only. Computed: 0.415.

cross_check.moon_targets_py_status: computed by src/moon_targets.py; verified=false until a person checks each value against the quicklook and the definition

moon_targets_py_computed.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF via src/moon_targets.py (Mateo, old definitions, 14 Nov 2026)

moon_dem_py_rim_to_floor.source: LOLA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF via src/moon_dem.py (30 m crop): rim median 1115 m, floor min -2872 m (data/results/moon_dem_summary.json)
moon_dem_py_rim_to_floor.why_unused: crater rim-to-floor depth, not c9 (5 km window at the low point); recompute c9 from LOLA
moon_dem_py_rim_to_floor.note: replaces a 4100 m placeholder from a chat format example. Spill depth (lowest rim saddle to floor) is 3752.5 m, see polar.computed.spill_depth_m.

cross_check.agreement: c7 0.1972 identical; spill depth 3752.5 vs 3752.9 m; equivalent diameter 19031 vs 19030 m; rim diameter 20.9 km both. Rim-to-floor differs: 3987 m (moon_dem.py, 30 m, rim median on a ring around a fitted centre) vs 4073 m (compute_lunar_target.py, 60 m, highest point per 1-deg azimuth within 1.3 x r). Unresolved; both are LOLA-based.
